title: Hold a motor dealer's licence
what: Hold a motor dealer's licence, for the place where the business is carried on, before dealing in motor vehicles.

sources.title: Motor Dealers and Repairers Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on, or advertise that the person carries on or is willing to carry on, the business of a motor dealer unless— (a) the person is the holder of a motor dealer's licence,
